sources.title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign: International Guidelines for Management of Sepsis and Septic Shock 2026 (SCCM/ESICM; Prescott H, et al. Crit Care Med, doi:10.1097/CCM.0000000000007075)
2025 Concise Clinical Guidance: an ACC expert consensus statement on the evaluation and management of cardiogenic shock (ACC; Sinha SS, et al. J Am Coll Cardiol, doi:10.1016/j.jacc.2025.02.018)
2024 Focused Update: Guidelines on Use of Corticosteroids in Sepsis, ARDS, and Community-Acquired Pneumonia (SCCM; Chaudhuri D, et al. Crit Care Med 2024;52(5):e219-e233)
ESICM guidelines on circulatory shock and hemodynamic monitoring 2025 (ESICM; Monnet X, et al. Intensive Care Med)

q_on_ne.text: Shock with MAP below target. Already on norepinephrine?

q_checks.text: Basics checked? (infusion running into the patient, arterial line reading true, volume status, bleeding, sedation effect)

q_cardiac.text: Echo: cardiac dysfunction with low output or persistent hypoperfusion?

q_cardiac_novaso.text: Vasopressin not available, so norepinephrine is the only vasopressor. Echo: cardiac dysfunction with low output or persistent hypoperfusion?

e_start_ne.title: Start norepinephrine
actions: Norepinephrine first line (septic shock: SSC 2026; cardiogenic shock: ACC 2025).
Dose and concentration per local infusion chart.
Peripheral start is acceptable in septic shock; do not delay for a central line.
Septic shock MAP target 65 mmHg (60-65 if age 65 or older).
Arterial line when on a vasopressor (ESICM 2025).
Cardiogenic shock: go to the pathway Cardiogenic shock.
cautions: SSC 2026 gives no norepinephrine dose; use the local infusion chart.
Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.

e_troubleshoot.title: Fix the basics first
actions: Check the infusion line, pump, concentration and connection.
Check arterial line zero, level and waveform; compare with cuff.
Test fluid responsiveness (passive leg raise, or end-expiratory occlusion if ventilated without spontaneous breaths).
Look for bleeding, tension pneumothorax, tamponade, and sedation-related hypotension.
Then return to this pathway.
cautions: This troubleshooting list is standard practice, not from the cited guideline.
Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.

e_see_cs.title: Cardiogenic: use the cardiogenic shock pathway
actions: Go to the pathway: Cardiogenic shock.
Get a 12-lead ECG and echo if not already done.
Call cardiology / regional shock centre early.
cautions: In cardiogenic shock, more vasoactive agents were linked with worse outcomes in observational data (ACC 2025): use the lowest dose for the shortest time.
Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.

e_unclear.title: Rising pressor need, type unclear
actions: Repeat echo (first-line for shock type, ESICM 2025).
Start cardiac output / stroke volume monitoring if not responding to initial therapy.
Re-examine for missed bleeding, obstruction, adrenal crisis or toxins.

Vasopressor meanwhile: continue norepinephrine titrated to the MAP target; if septic shock is possible and norepinephrine doses are escalating, SSC 2026 suggests adding vasopressin (dose per local infusion chart).
Senior review.
cautions: Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.

e_add_vaso.title: Add vasopressin
actions: SSC 2026 suggests adding vasopressin when norepinephrine doses are escalating.
Dose and concentration per local infusion chart.
Continue norepinephrine; titrate to the MAP target.
Consider IV corticosteroid per local protocol if not already started.
cautions: No guideline threshold for when to add vasopressin: the norepinephrine dose that triggers it is a local decision.
SSC 2026 gives no vasopressin dose.
Terlipressin is suggested against (SSC 2026).
Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.

e_inotrope.title: Add an inotrope
actions: Septic shock with cardiac dysfunction and persistent hypoperfusion: add dobutamine to norepinephrine, or use epinephrine alone (SSC 2026).
Dose and concentration per local infusion chart.
Consider IV corticosteroid per local protocol if not already started.
Monitor cardiac output and perfusion markers after each change (ESICM 2025).
cautions: SSC 2026 evidence here is very low certainty and gives no doses.
Cardiogenic shock is different: use the Cardiogenic shock pathway.
Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.

e_steroid.title: Start IV corticosteroid
actions: IV corticosteroid is suggested in septic shock (SSC 2026; SCCM 2024).
Use the low-dose regimen in the local protocol.
If MAP remains inadequate on norepinephrine plus vasopressin (or norepinephrine alone if vasopressin is unavailable): add epinephrine (SSC 2026).
cautions: Avoid high-dose short courses: over 400 mg/day hydrocortisone-equivalent for under 3 days (SCCM 2024).
No agent or dose is specified in the guideline sources reviewed: local protocol decision.
Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.

e_add_epi.title: Add epinephrine; treat as refractory
actions: SSC 2026 suggests adding epinephrine if MAP stays inadequate on norepinephrine plus vasopressin.
Vasopressin unavailable: SSC 2026 allows adding epinephrine to norepinephrine alone; whether to do this is a local decision.
Dose and concentration per local infusion chart.
Consultant review: recheck diagnosis, source control, cardiac function and goals of care.
Cardiac output monitoring if not already in place (ESICM 2025).
cautions: Watch for tachyarrhythmia and myocardial ischaemia (standard practice, not from the cited guideline).
Angiotensin II: no SSC 2026 recommendation beyond norepinephrine being preferred. Blood purification is suggested against.
Verify doses against local formulary/protocol.
